nodes.label: desktop memory - the user owns execution

Frozen copy taken 2026-08-03 of the desktop machine's memory file - the live directory sits on the other machine and is not reachable from here, so this copy is what there is to review. Listed unreviewed in REVIEW_REGISTER.md section 6. The user must be the one running things, in his own active terminal, watching live progress, because he owns the content and the progress. Background or shadow runs an agent kicks off are invisible to him and strip his ownership; the whole reason the work is scripts is so HE executes and follows them, and a run he cannot see may or may not be happening. Never run the smoke, eval or builds in the background for him - finish the code, then hand him the exact command to run - and make runs followable by emitting live progress, a counter or pips, to stdout so the terminal shows movement.
